Team —

We just had two last-minute drops from the panel for Sameer Patel (Backend Engineer, on the Rails infra slate): an unexpected travel conflict and an on-call incident. Sameer is already in-slot for next week, and I want to avoid rescheduling if possible — hiring velocity is important here.

Ask: can we recompose the panel using skill-driven fallbacks and a small "specialist lift" so we keep the slot and preserve coverage of core competency areas? I propose the following approach:

- Pair a systems-design specialist with a fallback proxy for infra/runtime questions (so we cover both design and performance).
- Keep the interview length as planned (60m) and use a focused 15m debrief template to capture signals for Hiring Team.
- If we need to swap, prioritize people with prior BE debriefs (faster scoring) or those who can do a quick shadow handoff.

Attachments: Sameer_Patel_resume.pdf (candidate), interview-slot-grid.xlsx (current slot matrix).

Please respond with: (1) whether you can take the slot; (2) which components you can cover (coding, system design, infra); (3) any calendar conflicts. I'll coordinate candidate-facing scheduling once we lock internal coverage.

Thanks —
Priyom
